contract: design-contract.md: read-only admin money operations; exact currency-separated balances, investigative links and explicit queue definitions in the existing admin design.

accessibility.evidence: axe WCAG2 A/AA and WCAG2.1 AA reported zero violations on desktop overview and mobile posting detail; GET filters have labels and read-only context is persistent.

responsive.evidence: Desktop queue and 390px overview/ledger/posting/record views have no document overflow. Tabular values, wrapped references and stacked mobile rows inspected.

loading.evidence: Delayed fixture API displays Loading the latest records before source rows render.

empty.evidence: Unmatched ledger filter shows No matching postings with clear filters.

error.evidence: Unavailable ledger API renders retry state; missing record has a dedicated not-found screen.

partial.evidence: Failed summary keeps ledger and reconciliation links available. Unknown event currency displays raw minor units.

success.evidence: Currency filter, linked reservation navigation, campaign wallet balances and loaded integrity status checked.

permission.evidence: Non-admin gets Administrator access needed; signed-out admin path redirects to signin. API e2e verifies all read boundaries and revoked role.

renderedEvidence.observation: Full-page overview captured from desktop viewport, with counts, integrity checks and separate NGN/USD balances.
Withdrawals review queue with reason, provider reference, amount and GET filters.
Admin navigation wraps, read-only note and metrics fit mobile width.
Signed-entry inspection stacks account context and debit/credit amounts.
Campaign-filtered wallet panel shows separate NGN and USD balances.
